notes: DirectConnect alarms can now be heard with your phone on silent. Loop plays each alarm's sound itself. Play Through Silent (on by default for Urgent Low and Falling Fast) plays the alarm even on silent, in a Focus, or with Loop alerts muted, and Urgent Low and Falling Fast keep playing until you open Loop or press OK. Each alarm has its own sound (Loop tones plus the xDrip4iOS sound library) and volume; tap a sound to hear it. After updating, open Settings → CGM → Glucose Alarms and test Urgent Low with your phone on silent.
